findings: Generated object replacement changes asset origin but leaves the weak visual argument: five floating subject symbols do not clarify how a profile relates to proposed formations.
Passport and dominant portrait signal general study-abroad or visa support more strongly than the specific academic matching tool.

Student photo, miniature still-life cutouts, white badge containers and paper/dotted collage lack a sufficiently coherent relationship in this execution; this is not a blanket rejection of ProTrain identity.
Three heavy tilted text bands compete at mobile scale; the long promise is dense and the CTA has large visual weight.
Arabic/French reading order remains decipherable and was inspected; typography is still optically awkward and heavy. Do not falsely reclassify correct bidi as broken.
Match label and field captions are too small to establish product recognition at phone size.
White CTA ribbon resembles another statement; telephone and historical website footer introduce competing action cues.
controller_responsibility: Previous review emphasized technical fidelity and bounded pixel changes, and underweighted persuasion, optical hierarchy and complete composition before delivery. Isolated micro-fixes were delivered without resolving the overall creative problem.
independent_review: Native bounded reviewer independently viewed full and phone exports and returned the same priority concerns.
scope: Critique and retained feedback only. No artwork edits, generation, copy rewrite, new layout, Creative02 or publication authorized/performed.
still_valid_evidence: V5 does use actual ImageGen raster assets, preserves exact copy and original fixed pixels, and retains existing identity. These technical facts do not establish creative approval or performance.
